title: hamamelis japonica subsp. megalophylla
intro: Hamamelis japonica subsp. megalophylla, commonly known as Japanese witch hazel, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Hamamelidaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and skin irritations, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of Japanese witch hazel include tannins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
